subject: reasoning
question: 35 is related to 48 following a certain logic. Following the same logic, 15 is related to 24. Which of the following is 80 related to, following the same logic? (NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g. 13-Operations on 13 such as adding/subtracting/ 1 multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)
solution:
Logic:

First no. = [(x)² -1]

Second no. = [(x + 1)2 -1]

35 is related to 48 →

​⇒ [(6)² - 1] = 35

​⇒ [(6 + 1)² - 1] = 48

15 is related to 24 →

​⇒ [(4)2 - 1] = 15

​⇒ [(4 + 1)2 - 1] = 24

Similarly, '143' will be related to:

80 is related to 99 →

​⇒ [(9)2 - 1] = 80

​⇒ [(9 + 1)2 - 1] = 99

Hence, the correct answer is "Option (1)".
